risks.risk: Model number not readable; pricing depends heavily on exact Yamaha model and key count/features.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model name/number label (usually on the back/underside) or the control panel text showing the exact model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Yamaha electronic keyboard of unknown model (worst-case for value among common used models).

risks.risk: Not all keys/sound functions may work (dead keys, stuck buttons, faulty speaker/amp).
risks.proof: Short video showing: press every key across the full range + switch a few instrument sounds + volume up/down + speaker output audible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed (worst-case: assume some functions may be faulty until tested).

risks.risk: Power/ports issue (adapter required, charging/power supply mismatch, headphone/USB/MIDI ports not working).
risks.proof: Photo of the exact power adapter/model used and a video showing it powering on reliably; also test headphone output or one port (USB/MIDI) if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming power/ports may need replacement or may be unreliable.

risks.risk: Display/backlight may work but other internal boards may be failing intermittently.
risks.proof: Video of the keyboard running for a few minutes while changing settings and playing continuously (no cut-outs).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially intermittent until proven stable.

Video test: play all keys (left to right), change sounds, and show volume/speaker working.
Show the power adapter and confirm stable power-on for a few minutes (no shutdown).
Test at least one external port (headphone out or USB/MIDI) with a quick clip.
